as_told.title: Lazar sees a wall go translucent

plain: A man named Bob Lazar says that around 1988 and 1989 he worked on a disc-shaped craft at a secret site in the Nevada desert called S-4. Speaking to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, he says he watched one of the craft's walls turn translucent, so you could partly see through it, and show symbols that looked three-dimensional. If true, it would mean the craft was built with technology far beyond anything people are known to make.
